items.title: Why ECB collateral eligibility could boost demand for tokenized bonds
items.summary: Past ECB decisions offer clues to the value of using bonds as collateral, while US derivatives exchanges face a different calculation over their Bitcoin holdings.

items.title: Hyperliquid’s HYPE will join bitcoin, ether and more in Franklin Templeton’s crypto ETF
items.summary: Franklin Templeton's Crypto Index ETF (EZPZ) will add Hyperliquid's HYPE token effective Dec.

items.title: Ether, DeFi fall twice as hard as bitcoin as equities selloff resumes
items.summary: Bitcoin (BTC) is down 1.2% since midnight UTC as the stock selloff resumes, with ether (ETH) and DeFi tokens falling about twice as far.

items.title: Bitcoin ETFs near $5B in record monthly outflows amid AI stock rout
items.summary: US spot Bitcoin ETFs have recorded $4.94 billion in November net outflows, exceeding the previous monthly record of $4.51 billion set in June.
